Name: AdjustmentValues
Expression:
UNION(
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        'InTrans_Parts_Adjust',
        "AdjustmentType", "Positive Adjustment $ (R12)",
        "AdjustmentValue", 
        CALCULATE(
            SUM('InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Cost]),
            'InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Cost] > 0,
            DATESINPERIOD(
                'InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Trans_Date],
                MAX('InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Trans_Date]),
                -12,
                MONTH
            )
        )
    ),
    SELECTCOLUMNS(
        'InTrans_Parts_Adjust',
        "AdjustmentType", "Negative Adjustment $ (R12)",
        "AdjustmentValue", 
        CALCULATE(
            SUM('InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Cost]),
            'InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Cost] < 0,
            DATESINPERIOD(
                'InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Trans_Date],
                MAX('InTrans_Parts_Adjust'[Trans_Date]),
                -12,
                MONTH
            )
        )
    )
)

Name: NegativeTable
Expression:
FILTER (
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        InTrans_Parts_Adjust,
        "Negative_QTY", IF ( InTrans_Parts_Adjust[QTY] < 0, InTrans_Parts_Adjust[QTY], BLANK() ),
        "Negative_Trans_Date", InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date]
    ),
    [Negative_QTY] <> BLANK()
)

Name: PositiveTable
Expression:
FILTER (
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        InTrans_Parts_Adjust,
        "Positive_QTY", IF ( InTrans_Parts_Adjust[QTY] > 0, InTrans_Parts_Adjust[QTY], BLANK() ),
        "Positive_Trans_Date", InTrans_Parts_Adjust[Trans_Date]
    ),
    [Positive_QTY] <> BLANK()
)

Name: CombinedTable
Expression:
UNION (
    SELECTCOLUMNS (
        NegativeTable,
        "Part_No", NegativeTable[Part_No],
        "QTY", NegativeTable[Negative_QTY],
        "Trans_Date", NegativeTable[Negative_Trans_Date],
        "Type", "Negative"
    ),
    SELECTCOLUMNS (
        PositiveTable,
        "Part_No", PositiveTable[Part_No],
        "QTY", PositiveTable[Positive_QTY],
        "Trans_Date", PositiveTable[Positive_Trans_Date],
        "Type", "Positive"
    )
)

Name: FilteredCombinedTable
Expression:
SUMMARIZE (
    CombinedTable,
    CombinedTable[Part_No],
    "Negative_QTY", CALCULATE ( SUM ( CombinedTable[QTY] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Negative" ),
    "Negative_Trans_Date", CALCULATE ( MAX ( CombinedTable[Trans_Date] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Negative" ),
    "Positive_QTY", CALCULATE ( SUM ( CombinedTable[QTY] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Positive" ),
    "Positive_Trans_Date", CALCULATE ( MAX ( CombinedTable[Trans_Date] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Positive" )
)

Name: SummarizedTable
Expression:
SUMMARIZE (
    CombinedTable,
    CombinedTable[Part_No],
    "Negative_QTY", CALCULATE ( SUM ( CombinedTable[QTY] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Negative" ),
    "Negative_Trans_Date", CALCULATE ( MAX ( CombinedTable[Trans_Date] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Negative" ),
    "Positive_QTY", CALCULATE ( SUM ( CombinedTable[QTY] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Positive" ),
    "Positive_Trans_Date", CALCULATE ( MAX ( CombinedTable[Trans_Date] ), CombinedTable[Type] = "Positive" )
)
